title: AI Drama Generator: Make a Vertical Micro Drama Series
summary: Make a micro drama series with Flick's AI drama generator: cast your leads, write the lines and shoot vertical episodes that end on a hook. Start free.
body_markdown:
### What is an AI drama generator?


An AI drama generator is a tool that turns a premise into the parts of a drama: characters, dialogue and generated scenes. In Flick, it plans a series with you in chat, then generates each episode's shots on one canvas, with the cast kept consistent.


### What is a micro drama?


A micro drama is a series of very short episodes made to watch on a phone, usually shot vertically, where each episode ends on a cliffhanger. Romance, revenge and family secrets are common stories, because each turns on one line or one reveal.


### Can AI make a vertical drama series?


Yes. Set the Flick project to 9:16 before you generate, and images and clips come out tall for phones. Frame faces in close-up, since a narrow screen leaves little room for wide shots.


### How do I keep the same characters in every episode?


Make a character sheet of each lead, a headshot plus full body front and back on a plain background, and cite it in every shot they appear in. Keep the whole series in one project, so later episodes reuse the same sheets.


### Can AI characters speak dialogue?


Yes. Write the line in quotes with who says it and how, and generate with a video model that makes sound, such as Seedance 2.5 or Kling O3 Pro in Flick. Add “no background music” to keep a score out of the shot.


### Is Flick's AI drama generator free?


Yes, you can start free: you get 100 credits when you sign up, 200 more for joining the Flick Discord, and 100 credits every week. The free plan has AI chat, image models and MiniMax H3 Max video; Seedance and Kling need the Standard plan ($20 a month).


### How is a micro drama different from an AI drama short film?


A micro drama is a series of short vertical episodes built around cliffhangers, while a drama short film tells one complete story in one sitting. Flick's guide on[how to make an AI drama short film](https://flick.art/blog/guides/how-to-make-an-ai-drama-short-film) covers the single film, step by step.
